title: ECOWITT_SOIL_CHANNEL_MAP_JSON
description: Runtime config payload for the Verdant EcoWitt live soil bridge. Maps EcoWitt soilmoisture channel keys to a single Verdant tent (and optional plant + label). One bridge process → one tent → one bridge token is enforced separately at startup; this schema only validates shape and value ranges.

tent_id.description: UUID of the tent this soil channel belongs to.

plant_id.description: Optional UUID of the plant this soil probe is inserted in.

label.description: Optional human-readable label for operator logs.
